Во время выпечки поверхность ынджеры покрывается дырками или ямками. Когда вся ынджера подрумянится цвет и края начнут подниматься над сковородой, её следует снять и отложить в сторону, а затем налить следующую порцию теста и повторять так пока оно не закончится.

recipes.title: Экзотический салат из креветок
steps: Главное – не переварить креветки, чтобы они не стали «резиновыми». Опустите замороженные креветки в кипящую воду, как только вода закипит - доставайте и чистите их. Огурцы очистите от кожицы, порежьте крупной соломкой. Перемешайте с креветками, мелко порезанными крабовыми палочками, помидорками и зеленью. В салатницу положите листики зеленого салата, а на них горкой выложите приготовленный салат.
Сметану взбейте с майонезом в пропорции 1:1, добавьте по вкусу соль, перец, рубленый чеснок и немного кетчупа – соус должен получиться бледно-розового цвета. Полученным соусом заправьте салат.
А допускается поступить еще проще - креветки сбрызнуть лимоном, полить соусом, посыпать зеленью.

recipes.title: Эскабече

ingredients.item: растительное масло (можно взять оставшееся после жарки рыбы)

steps: Если используется оставшееся после жарки рыбы масло — процедить его.
Масло разогреть, обжарить в нём лук. Добавить чеснок, муку, перец и уксус.
Хорошо нагреть и добавить воду. Перемешать, посолить и варить 5-6 минут.

recipes.title: Эчпочмак

ingredients.item: тесто: 90 г (на 1 кг муки: дрожжи прессованные 20-40 г, соль 12-15 г, вода или молоко 350-450 г, яйца 2-3 шт, сахар-песок 30-40 г, масло сливочное — 50 г.)
начинка: мяса 60—70 г, картофеля 80 г, репчатого лука 20 г (мелко нарезанный), масла топленого 15 г

steps: Мясо промыть, отделить от костей, нарезать мелкими кубиками величиной с лесной орех.
Так же нарезать чищенный картофель, положить в холодную воду, чтобы не потемнел.
Картофель откинуть на сито, дать стечь воде, добавить мясо, лук, масло, перец и соль и все тщательно перемешать; начинку уложить в глубокую посуду.
Муку просеять. Развести дрожжи в тёплой воде или молоке.
Высыпать в посуду треть взятой муки и тщательно размешать.
Замешанную опару слегка посыпать мукой и на 2-3 часа поставить в тёплое место для брожения (при этом её температура должна быть 30-35°).

Объём опары увеличится примерно в два раза и по готовности она начнёт опадать. Добавить в неё воду, масло, сахар, соль, пряности, высыпать остальную часть муки и замесить тесто, чтобы не прилипало к рукам и легко отставало от посуды.
Поставить тесто для брожения в теплое место. Когда тесто подойдёт (через 1-2 часа), его надо обмять и дать вновь подойти. Обминку теста желательно делать два раза.
Дрожжевое тесто разделать на шарики весом около 90 г и раскатать на ле­пёшки размером с чайное блюдце.
На лепёшку положить приготовленную начин­ку, приподнять с трех сторон края теста, защипать узорчика­ми, а в середине оставить отверстие и закрыть пробками из теста.
Эчпочмаки положить на смазанный маслом противень или сковороду, смазать верх сырым яйцом и посадить в печь или духовку.
Через пол­часа вынуть, открыть отверстие, налить внутрь бульон, закрыть пробкой, снова поставить в печь и выпекать до готовности.

recipes.title: Юварлакия

ingredients.item: мясной фарш (говядина или смесь со свининой) — 500 г
соль, черный молотый перец — по вкусу

steps: В глубокой миске соединить фарш, промытый рис, натёртый лук, укроп, петрушку, оливковое масло, соль и перец. Тщательно вымесить фарш руками и слегка отбить его о дно миски.
Скатать круглые тефтели размером с крупный грецкий орех.

В кастрюле вскипятить воду или бульон, добавить ложку сливочного масла и немного соли. Поочерёдно опустить фрикадельки в кипящую жидкость. Убавить огонь, накрыть крышкой и варить 30 минут до мягкости риса, после чего снять с огня.
В отдельной емкости взбить венчиком яйца до лёгкой пены, затем тонкой струйкой, не прекращая взбивать, влить лимонный сок.
Закаливание соуса: продолжая активно работать венчиком, влить в яично-лимонную смесь 2 половника горячего бульона из кастрюли.

Медленно вылить получившуюся смесь обратно в кастрюлю, аккуратно покачивая ее круговыми движениями для объединения. Вернуть на минимальный огонь на 2 минуты для загустения, ни в коем случае не доводя до кипения. Дать настояться 10 минут под крышкой.

recipes.title: Яблоки с творогом
steps: Для приготовления блюда разрезать яблоки на две половины, сердцевину и часть мякоти вырезать. Для сохранения цвета полить лимонным соком яблоки, измельчить удалённую мякоть. Отварить и порезать курагу. Смешать мякоть яблок, курагу, творог, яйцо, мёд, ванилин и перемешать. В нагретой до 180 градусов духовке запекать в течение 15 минут заполненные смесью половинки яблок. Готовое блюдо можно украсить листьями мяты.

recipes.title: Яблочный пирог

ingredients.item: яблоки свежие 30 фунтов (13,61 кг) ИЛИ 8 фунтов (3,63 кг) сушёных яблочных колец

steps: Просеять через сито муку и соль, вмешать маргарин и сделать углубление. Добавить воду и замесить крутое тесто.
Дать отстояться, разделить на 16 частей, если используются штатные противни (?) либо на 2 части (всего 48 порций).
Сухофрукты замочить на 24 часа, затем поставить вариться вместе с сахаром и довести до полуготовности. Добавить гвоздику и продолжать варить.
Раскатать тесто в пласт толщиной 1/6 дюйма (ок. 4 мм)
Покрыть противни пергаментной бумагой, смазать жиром, проделать в бумаге отверстия; выложить яблоки, и накрыть слоем теста.
Тесто сверху смазать водой или молоком, присыпать сахаром и кончиком ножа наметить порции.
Поместить в верхнюю часть духовки (350 F / 175 C) и выпекать от 40 минут до одного часа, до готовности начинки и теста. Нижний слой теста осматривать, соблюдая меры предосторожности.

recipes.title: Яйца-пашот

ingredients.item: уксус: 1 ст. л. на литр воды

steps: Ополоснуть готовые яйца в холодной воде, а затем до подачи держать их в горячей подсоленной воде (из расчёта 6 г на литр).
(Количество некоторых ингредиентов в оригинале не указано)

Яйца выпускныя. Oeufs pochés Яйца выпускныя приготовляются такъ: въ кипящую ключемъ воду, въ кастрюлю или сотейникъ, почти до верху наполненные водою, влить нѣсколько ложекъ уксуса; самыя свѣжія яйца выпускать по одному на блюдечко и съ него осторожно, но быстро, спускать ихъ на поверхность кипящей воды, затѣмъ шумовкою очень осторожно способствовать тому, чтобъ яйцо въ кипящей водѣ поворачивалось и чтобы такимъ образомъ бѣлокъ правильно обвалакивалъ желтокъ. Черезъ двѣ минуты яйцо сварится такъ, что бѣлокъ сдѣлается сравнительно твердымъ, а желтокъ будетъ всмятку, тогда шумовкою вынуть яйцо, обровнять ножомъ края неправильной формы, положить его въ тепловатую воду и продолжать тѣмъ же порядкомъ варить остальныя яйца.

Яйца выпускныя и въ мѣшечекъ, до отпуска ихъ, должны быть погружены въ тепловатую воду, которая, передъ самымъ отпускомъ, должна быть посолена и подогрѣта. Способы подачи выпускныхъ яицъ описаны ниже въ.№№ 1467 — 1409, 1471 — 1474, 1478.

recipes.title: Яйца по-бургундски

ingredients.item: красное вино: 1 л (предпочтительно выдержанное, с сильным ароматом)

steps: Вскипятить вино в медной кастрюле. Процедить через салфетку, выпарить вдвое.
Добавить мучное масло, снять с огня.
Выложить яйца на смазанные маслом поджаренные тосты и полить полученным соусом.

recipes.title: Яйца по-флорентийски
steps: Шпинат бланшировать в кипятке, отжать, отварить в сливочном масле, приправить мускатным орехом, солью, перцем, уложить на противень.
Яйца-пашот (просушенные) разложить поверх шпината, равномерно залить соусом морне, посыпать тёртым сыром, полить растопленным сливочным маслом.
Поставить противень в духовку и зарумянить яйца при большом верхнем огне.
Выложить дно и стенки кокотницы тонким слоем стушенного в сливочном масле шпината. Вбить яйцо, приправить и тушить на малом огне.
Когда основание яйца затвердеет, полить ложкой сливок, посыпать тёртым сыром и быстро зарумянить верх в духовке.

recipes.title: Яйцо по-шотландски
steps: Мясо измельчите на мясорубке с мелкой сеточкой. Или смешайте готовый мясной фарш с измельчённым свежим базиликом, солью и перцем. Слегка отбейте (аккуратно бросая в миску), чтобы фарш хорошо держался на яйце.
Сварите 6 яиц (не больше 5 минут после закипания), остудите под холодной водой и очистите.
Разделите фарш на шесть равных частей. Каждую часть мокрыми руками распластайте в лепёшку, положите на нее варёное яйцо. Залепите края фарша так, чтобы яйцо оказалось внутри.
Котлетку из фарша с яйцом внутри обваляйте в муке. Затем обмакните в сырое яйцо, которое предварительно нужно немного взбить вилкой и посолить.
Затем обваляйте яйцо-котлетку в панировочных сухарях. Панировка должна покрыть яйцо по-шотландски со всех сторон.

Хорошо разогрейте на среднем огне достаточное для фритюра количество растительного рафинированного масла. Аккуратно выкладывайте мясные зразы с яйцом в горячее масло и обжаривайте на среднем огне с каждой стороны по 5-7 минут, чтобы говядина хорошо прожарилась.
Готовые яйца по-шотландски выкладывайте на бумажную салфетку, чтобы масло впиталось.
Подавайте яйца по-шотландски со свежей зеленью или овощами. Можно подавать это блюдо и горячим, и холодным.

recipes.title: Ятернице
steps: Хлеб выжимается, мясо шинкуется, перемешивается с хлебом и специями. Полученным наполняются свиные кишки. Ятернице варятся, потом охлаждаются.

recipes.title: 冷中華

ingredients.item: 中华面（中国的中式面条）

steps: 中华面煮熟后，用冷水冲凉，沥干水分。
黄瓜、番茄切丝。
火腿切丝，或用鸡肉煮熟后切丝。
鸡蛋煎成薄饼后切丝。
豆芽轻轻焯水后冷却，沥干水分。
调味料混合制成酱料（根据个人口味调整酱油、醋、糖、芝麻油、盐和胡椒的比例）。
在盘子中放入中华面，放上黄瓜、番茄、火腿、鸡蛋和豆芽。
倒入调好的酱料，搅拌均匀后即可享用。

recipes.title: 咖啡果冻

ingredients.item: 35克咖啡糖（份量随个人口味调整，可以替换为其他甜味剂）
3汤匙（相当于45立方厘米）即溶咖啡粉（份量随个人口味调整）
奶精（随个人口味决定是否加入）

steps: 把咖啡粉、糖、奶精加到锅里。
把鱼胶粉加到锅里，接着马上加入100毫升热开水，并开始小火加热，适当搅拌，直至所有粉末煮溶为止。
停止加热后，加入150毫升冷开水，并搅拌。
把混合物分批加到果冻杯里，放到冰箱冷藏室，冷藏两至四个小时，食用。

recipes.title: 咖喱鱼蛋
steps: 魚蛋飛水，洗淨，瀝乾。
以慢火燒熱少許油，爆香洋葱及蒜茸，加入咖喱粉炒至滲出咖喱香。
注入清湯以大火烋滾，加調味料及咖喱膏拌勻，加入魚蛋，煮滾後轉慢火煮魚蛋漲。
拌入椰醬，蓋上，熄火，將魚蛋浸3小時或以上至入味便可享用。

recipes.title: 大蒜烧肥肠
steps: 炒锅至旺火上，烧热猪油，白糖炒化，掺水少许，炒成不深不浅的糖汁；下肥肠在糖汁中炒上色，掺汤烧开，撇尽浮沫；加盐葱姜花椒，用小火煨至七成烂时加大蒜；直至全烂后加味精，再用水豆粉勾芡起锅。

recipes.title: 天下第一菜

ingredients.item: 主辅料：饭锅巴100克、大虾仁200克、熟鸡丝100克、番茄酱100克。
调料：精盐3克、黄酒25克、白糖50克、味精2克、白醋10克、鸡蛋清1个，干生粉l0克、水生粉25克、鸡清汤500克、麻油10克、色拉油1000克（约耗50克）。

steps: 将大虾仁洗净漂清，沥去水，放人碗中，加精盐（1克）、鸡蛋清，用干生粉搅和至上劲，投入温油锅中划过，备用；
将锅置于旺火上，舀入鸡清汤，放入虾仁、熟鸡丝、精盐（2克）、黄酒、白糖、味精、番茄酱烧沸，用水生粉勾芡，再加白醋；
将锅置于旺火上，舀入色拉油，烧至七成热，放人饭锅巴，炸至发脆，捞入碗中，再将鸡虾卤汁盛入另一碗中。两只碗同时迅速上桌，将卤汁倒在锅巴碗中即成。

recipes.title: 奶酪包飯

ingredients.item: 一包片狀奶酪，視乎個人口味，建議用較薄的款式。
隔夜飯或不想吃的飯食，份量約一豌。建議不要白飯，而是夾雜一些肉粒、豆子或粟米的飯食。

steps: 把飯食倒在錫紙上，堆成錐台形狀。
在飯食上鋪上片狀奶酪，建議覆蓋頂面和側面。
用烤箱內設的鐵盤承載，放進烤箱裏烤，大約要十五分鐘。
烤完即可食用，但務必先檢查中心位置的飯粒是否已加熱。如果有冷飯的情況，極度建議重新加熱，以免衛生問題。

recipes.title: 姜汁拐肉

ingredients.item: 猪拐肉（即大腿根部的肉）500克

steps: 1 猪拐肉刮洗干净，汤煮至软后捞起。
2 将煮软的锅肉切成2厘米见方的方块。
3 生姜刮去皮，用刀拍破宰细，放于碗内；加油、盐、酱、醋、芝麻油、味精与少许汤兑成姜汁调料。
4 切成的拐肉用汤冒热，成于盘内，淋上姜汁即可食用。

recipes.title: 左宗棠鸡
steps: 雞腿肉切成一口大小，加入醬油、米酒、白胡椒、蛋抓勻，最後加太白粉或玉米粉拌到表面黏黏的。
油溫約 170–180°C，把雞肉一塊塊下鍋炸到金黃。撈起後等 1–2 分鐘，再回鍋炸一次 30–60 秒，會更酥。
把醬油、糖、醋、番茄醬、米酒、水、太白粉先在碗裡混合好。
鍋中留一點油，放蒜末、薑末、乾辣椒炒香。不要炒焦，不然會苦。
倒入醬汁煮到冒泡變濃，立刻放入炸好的雞肉快速翻炒，讓每塊雞都裹上醬。
起鍋前撒蔥花、白芝麻即可。

recipes.title: 巧克力脆脆米通
steps: 一边煮熔黄油，一边用木匙轻力搅拌。
加入棉花糖，轻力搅拌，与黄油混和并煮熔。
加入巧克力脆米，轻力搅拌，让每颗脆米都沾上棉花糖浆。
把脆米倒到牛油纸，趁热把米通塑造成自己喜欢的形状（推介棒状），放凉以后享用。

recipes.title: 提拉米蘇

ingredients.item: 約35克咖啡糖、白糖或甜味劑（份量隨個人口味調整）
約30克咖啡粉（份量隨個人口味調整）
約100克鮮奶油（份量隨個人口味調整）
約250克奶酪（份量隨個人口味調整）
少量香草油（份量隨個人口味調整，可不加入）

steps: 一、先把咖啡粉和糖水溶到熱水中，製成濃咖啡，放在小玻璃盆裡備用。
二、把鮮奶油加到一個玻璃碗裡，再打發約20分鐘，直至拌起鮮奶油後不會掉下來（如圖所示）。
Making Tiramisù at home 02.jpg
Making Tiramisù at home 03.jpg
Making Tiramisù at home 04.jpg
三、把奶酪放到另一個玻璃碗，稍為搗爛。接下來把鮮奶油分批加到奶酪中（不宜同時加入），每次加入鮮奶油後均需攪拌，直至形成淡黃色混合物。全部鮮奶油與奶酪混合後，可加入少量香草油，並再次攪拌成混合物。
Making Tiramisù at home 08.jpg
Making Tiramisù at home 01.jpg
Making Tiramisù at home 05.jpg
四、把手指餅乾逐塊快速沾進小玻璃盆的濃咖啡裡（速度必須適當，不可太快或太慢），再放到大玻璃盆裡，密鋪成一層（如圖所示）；然後，將一些奶酪和鮮奶油的混合物平鋪到手指餅乾層上。鋪滿後，重複此步驟幾遍，製成多層（如圖所示）。
Making Tiramisù at home 06.jpg
Making Tiramisù at home 09.jpg
Making Tiramisù at home 11.jpg
五、鋪上最頂層的混合物後，灑上巧克力粉，作為裝飾。
Making Tiramisù at home 10.jpg
Making Tiramisù at home 07.jpg
Making Tiramisù at home 12.jpg
六、在大玻璃盆上蓋好保鮮膜，放到冰箱冷藏室，冷藏最少四小時。食用時可先切去手指餅乾突出的部分，以提升賣相。

recipes.title: 枸杞糕

ingredients.item: 枸杞适量（分量随个人口味而定）
黄冰糖适量（分量随个人口味而定，由于市售的枸杞带酸味，建议尽可能多放糖；黄冰糖能给予色泽和味道，不建议用其他甜味剂代替）
鱼胶粉18克（分量随个人口味而定）

steps: 预备一碗枸杞和黄冰糖，加入热开水（预留一点热开水供下一个步骤使用），轻轻搅拌，然后静置或搅拌约十分钟。
把鱼胶粉溶在少许热开水，再把溶液经筛子倒进刚才的枸杞水里面。
轻轻搅拌混合物，再放到冰箱冷藏室，冷藏两至五个小时，食用。

recipes.title: 柱侯牛腩

ingredients.item: 醃料：花椒、八角、米酒、花紅粉、薑、滷水、雞湯和柱侯醬

steps: 醃好的牛腩用中火煮，再用慢火煲一小時左右而成。

recipes.title: 梨炒雞
steps: 取雛雞胸肉切片，先用豬油三兩熬熟，炒三四次，加麻油一瓢，芡粉、鹽花、薑汁、花椒末各一茶匙，再加雪梨薄片、香蕈小塊，炒三四次起鍋，盛五寸盤。

recipes.title: 洋葱汤

ingredients.item: 蒜头6瓣（可随个人喜好调整分量；用作提高汤的香味，强烈建议加入）
黄油20克（可随个人喜好调整分量；用作提高汤的香味，强烈建议加入）
盐、胡椒粉、黑胡椒粉各少许（可随个人喜好调整分量）

steps: 洋葱切片，蒜头剁成蒜蓉。
加少许油到锅裏，稍微加热，再放入洋葱。
炒洋葱，中途加入蒜蓉，然后继续炒，直至洋葱变得柔软。
煮沸700毫升的水，再把沸水加到锅裏，中火煮15分钟。
用手提电动搅拌器捣烂锅裏的洋葱，直至所有洋葱被捣烂为止。
加入黄油、盐、胡椒粉、黑胡椒粉，稍作搅拌。
倒到碗里享用。

recipes.title: 滷味

ingredients.item: 滷味包 1份(各大超市皆可購買)
紅辣椒 未切1個(壓味料)
其它(蔥,薑,糖...等提味料) 適量(選項)
去腥味用(米酒,或味醂),如果是具有腥味的食材的話, 可適量使用

steps: 先製作滷汁, 再加入食材煮熟
如有不易煮熟的食材, 切小塊, 或是有血水的先川燙過, 再滷
例如:整隻雞去雞毛, 去內臟後不切, 先用水煮到半熟後再滷

recipes.title: 炸乾辣椒
steps: 選擇小又硬的辣椒，用水洗淨後，拿剪刀剪開一條縫作為通氣孔，避免油煎時炸開。
在備好的辣椒上面均勻抹上糯米粉，然後在燒開的蒸鍋上蒸一段時間。
將作法2的材料放在陽光下晒涼，約每天晒2-3小時，晒3天左右。
晒乾的辣椒以170度的油溫炸後即可食用,

recipes.title: 炸沙參
steps: 沙參去皮，豎著切開後，敲打攤開，並放入淡鹽水中去苦澀味道，然後去水分。
將沙參均勻沾好糯米粉之後，在160度的油中煎炸。（在糯米粉是乾粉的情況下稍加水分，並用篩子篩過的糯米粉來沾沙參。）
沾砂糖或蜂蜜一起食用，若當下酒菜，還可沾醋醬（食醋+ 辣醬）一起食用。

recipes.title: 炸麻叶
steps: 用一般的白面和水然后把准备好的芝麻炒一炒，但是切记不能烧糊，炒好之后感觉到芝麻的香味就和白面以及盐在一起搅拌。发好的面放在按板上用刀切成相对均匀的菱形，放入油锅中炸熟至金黄色即可，炸好的麻叶十分香甜可口，也就意味着在这一年年岁里就有香味【美满】。
一般在河南当地家中过年走亲戚或是亲朋好友见面都会见到这一美食【炸麻叶】，这已经是一种传统一直保留到现在。

recipes.title: 烧仙草
steps: 煮好備用。(若无材料可以八寶粥代替)

recipes.title: 煮蘋果
steps: 蘋果削皮去芯，切八等分。
將切片好的蘋果與蘋果汁放入鍋中，小火煮約10分鐘。
在蘋果汁收乾之前，起鍋，灑上砂糖與肉桂後，放涼食用。

recipes.title: 蒸大蝦
steps: 大蝦洗淨，切開蝦背，將虾放入蒸碗中，撒上鹽、清酒、白胡椒粉。
將生姜洗淨去皮后切成薄片，放入作法1中。
將裝蝦的蒸碗放入蒸鍋中，蒸7-8分鐘，再將蝦取出，把煮蝦的湯放入其他碗中。
將蒸好的蝦去頭、去皮，切成3cm厚的薄片。
將牛肉煮熟並切成薄片。
黃瓜斜切成薄片，撒上少許鹽浸出水分，然後擠掉水分，再將它放在燒熱的平鍋上稍炒。煮好的竹筍也切成薄片稍炒。然後將炒好的黃瓜、竹筍放在大盤子上攤開放涼。
將松子切碎製成松子末，和鹽、麻油、白胡椒粉一起，加入煮蝦的湯均勻攪拌。
容器中放入牛肉、黃瓜、竹筍，連同松子佐料鋪在蝦上。

recipes.title: 班兰茶果

ingredients.item: 班兰叶10至15克（也可使用班兰香精）
食用油20克（建议使用花生油或猪油）
白糖8克（如果想制作咸茶果，则不加白糖）

steps: 把糯米粉和普通面粉经过筛子加到大碗，再加入盐和白糖。
把食用油加到大碗，用大木匙搅拌均匀。
班兰叶放到一锅沸腾的开水，中火烹煮10至15分钟，直至开水变成淡黄色的班兰水。
把其中100毫升班兰水加到刚才的大碗，用大木匙搅拌均匀。
捏起一小块粉团，搓成球状茶果，直至全部粉团用完为止。
把茶果放到蒸锅，大火蒸15分钟，完成。

recipes.title: 生菜米纸虾卷
steps: 將上等紙米泡水軟化，吸乾水分後，依序將高麗菜絲、九層塔、川燙過的蝦仁放到紙米上捲起包緊。

recipes.title: 生魚片
steps: 将海鲜切成大片
山葵和酱油混合
海鲜沾族酱油/山葵
即可

recipes.title: 白飯
steps: 洗米
加水
蓋上鍋蓋，大火煮至沸騰。中途勿開鍋蓋
水沸後（鍋子會冒出明顯白煙），立即開鍋蓋，快速徹底攪拌一下米飯
蓋上鍋蓋，轉小火繼續煮10到15分鐘
燜一下。完成

recipes.title: 盐煮马铃薯

ingredients.item: 一口大小的小型馬鈴薯
（通常會使用「Size B, Grade US No. 2」標準的馬鈴薯製作）
通常4磅的馬鈴薯中會添加1磅的鹽來烹煮
約為一杯鹽配上六杯水

steps: 將馬鈴薯的表皮以粗布擦洗，然後後再煮沸。
在煮沸水時，添加鹽。
在鹽水中煮過後，在鹽水中添加熔化的黃油。
烹煮後的馬鈴薯呈現乳狀，而馬鈴薯皮則帶鹹味。

recipes.title: 竹蔗水

ingredients.item: 冰糖、黃糖或片糖，分量隨個人口味決定。

steps: 把甘蔗、茅根、胡蘿蔔、荸薺等材料放到鍋裡，再加入適量水，煮最少三小時。
完成後加糖攪拌，即可飲用，也可冷藏後飲用。

recipes.title: 米浆
steps: 分別將蓬萊米、花生，用食物調理機磨成細粉。
將上述兩種粉末加水與糖，煮開。
如果覺得香味不足，則是加入乾炒過的白芝麻，所磨成得粉末，繼續煮。

recipes.title: 糖醋松鼠魚
steps: 糖醋松鼠魚重視片魚的刀功，先把魚肉片出後，抹上蛋液、沾太白粉下鍋油炸，起鍋後放進蔥、薑、蒜、辣椒爆香；續加入糖以及醋調味，再加入少許太白粉勾芡，最後放上香菜擺飾便完成。

recipes.title: 紅燒獅子頭

ingredients.item: 上等豬絞肉100克(瘦肉與肥肉比例3:1)，蛋清，洋蔥(切成細末)
山東大白菜，香菇(泡開切絲)
蔥，薑，蒜，醬油，糖，米酒，太白粉(調成太白粉水)

steps: 猪肉肥瘦各半，细切粗斩，乃和以蛋白，使易凝固，或加虾仁、蟹粉。以黄沙罐一，底置黄芽菜或竹笋，略和以水及盐，以肉作极大之圆，置其上，上覆菜叶，以罐盖盖之，乃入铁锅，撒盐少许，以防锅裂。然后，以文火干烧之。每烧数把柴一停，约越五分时更烧之，侯熟取出。
將絞肉與洋蔥末、蛋白拌勻,可加入些許鹽. 捏成所需的大小,以160度的熱油炸(可事先丸子上抹油,能避免沾鍋),炸好後備用
先將鍋子預熱(中火),加入油將蔥,薑,蒜下鍋爆香後,加入香菇絲'大白菜拌炒,再加入醬油,糖等調味料.加2碗的水.煮滾轉小火. 蓋上鍋蓋悶1~2個小時(視丸子大小而定),最後以太白粉水勾芡,準備起鍋.可滴些香油'增加香味.

recipes.title: 紅豆泥
steps: 先將紅豆泡水，紅豆在吸足水分後，體積會膨脹。
將紅豆用蒸的，蒸熟後。
將蒸熟後的紅豆絞碎。
加入砂糖熬煮攪拌均勻，使水分收乾。須留意攪拌，以免鍋子焦底。
放涼後，冷藏保存備用‧

recipes.title: 純素法式鹹派

ingredients.item: 腰果半杯，泡水一小時以上，濾乾

steps: 烤箱預熱至190度。
熱油鍋，加入菠菜，煮軟，加少許鹽和胡椒粉調味。
用食物料理機將腰果打成泥狀。加入豆腐、營養酵母、豆漿、薑黃粉，繼續打勻。
混和2和3步骤的混合物，加入鹽和胡椒粉調味。
將派皮鋪在派盤上，再將4倒入派皮中，抹平，撒上紅椒粉和番茄片。放入烤箱烤約30至40分鐘。

recipes.title: 翻糖蛋糕

ingredients.item: 基础蛋糕一小块（可以购买现成或自行制作）
调色粉适量（可使用天然色素或人造色素，也可不用）

steps: 把糖粉经粉筛加到大碗中，备用。
把牛油紙铺在工作台上，并用胶带固定四角，把一半先前准备的糖粉倒在牛油紙上。
在木匙的凹陷部分涂抹黄油。
把黄油涂满在锅的内壁，再把棉花糖加到锅里，加热至融化，期间一直用木匙搅拌。
如果要制作白色翻糖，就务必小心控制加热时间，以免煮成焦糖。
如果要制作黄色翻糖，就把棉花糖煮至金黄，但注意不要煮至深啡色。
棉花糖完全融化后，把剩下的一半糖粉倒进锅里，期间一直用木匙搅拌。
待糖粉溶进糖浆以后，把整锅糖浆倒在先前准备的牛油紙，并加入水。
戴上耐热手套，用手把牛油紙上的糖浆与糖粉混和，直至形成固化的糖胶，即为翻糖。
如果需要调色，就用手把调色粉混进翻糖，并进行混和，直至翻糖成色均匀。
在蛋糕表面涂上薄薄的一层黄油，然后用擀麵棍把翻糖压平，把翻糖铺到蛋糕表面。
切下剩余的翻糖，用作装饰。

recipes.title: 老婆饼
steps: 中筋麵粉，糖粉，水，豬油。
低筋麵粉，花生油。
糖冬瓜，白芝麻，椰絲，糖（若不想太甜可減少或不加），鹽，豬油，水，糯米麵粉。

recipes.title: 蛤蛎蒸蛋

ingredients.item: 蛤蠣: 少許 (先用自來水沖洗乾淨後, 泡水, 加幾滴米醋, 催吐沙粒後, 備用)
魚板: 少許 (切碎後, 備用)
豬腦: 少許 (提味用, 切碎後備用, 怕吃豬腦或怕高膽固醇的人可以不用加這項)
或是其他你想加進蒸蛋裡的食材

steps: 先準備好高湯, 放到稍涼後, 備用
打蛋, 加入高湯, 雞蛋與高湯的比例大約1:1, 攪拌均勻即可, 別打到起泡
在碗裡陸續放入蒸蛋裡的食材, 稍微攪拌一下即可, 然後隔水加熱 (或用蒸籠)
最後,準備一個瓜仔肉的罐頭,稍微加熱過後,把罐頭上頭的那層油倒出來(那個油可以用來炒其他的青菜),然後蒸蛋出爐後,加點瓜仔肉上去

recipes.title: 西班牙小饼

ingredients.item: 200克經烤箱以攝氏200度烘烤15分鐘的低筋麵粉
少量未經烘烤的低筋麵粉
120克經冰箱冷藏、再在室溫下放軟的無鹽黃油
約70克糖粉（份量隨個人口味調整）
約一小茶匙肉桂粉（份量隨個人口味調整）

steps: 用膠刮攪拌黃油，令黃油更細滑。
把糖粉、蛋黄和肉桂粉加到黃油，攪拌均勻。
300px|无框|无
加入經过烘烤的低筋麵粉，用膠刮攪拌成面团。
300px|无框|无
在桌面（铺上保鲜纸）或砧板上撒少许没有烘烤的低筋麵粉。把面团放到上面，搓成圆柱状，再切成小圆饼，建议厚度为一至两厘米。
300px|无框|无
把小圆饼排在鋪上烘焙紙的烤盤上，放进烤箱，以攝氏160度烘烤10至15分鐘，直至表面变成金黄色。
在室温下冷却，洒上糖粉，食用。

recipes.title: 豆腐脑

ingredients.item: 8克黃糖／紅糖（份量隨個人口味調整）
7克魚膠粉（決定豆腐脑的凝固程度，份量隨個人口味調整）

steps: 先把魚膠粉溶解到一小杯冷水中，足以完全溶解即可，注意必須保持快速攪拌，以免溶液凝固成固體。
把豆漿倒進量杯，然後倒到鍋裡，用中火加熱。
豆漿煮沸後，調至小火。通過篩子加入魚膠粉溶液，期間保持攪拌。
調回中火，邊攪拌邊加熱，直至煮沸。期間可加入黃糖或紅糖，也可以在食用時才灑上。
无框|无
把煮好的豆漿通過篩子倒到大豌，放涼一會後用保鮮膜蓋好大豌，放到冰箱冷藏室，冷藏大概三至四小時。凝固後即可食用。
无框|无

recipes.title: 韩式泡菜火锅
steps: 沙拉油放入鍋內加熱，收入泡菜、韓國辣椒醬及辣椒粉拌抄。
將１加入水及泡菜湯汁。
將三層肉及豆腐切塊放入鍋中續煮。
再加入蔥（蔥切段）及蒜末煮十五分鐘即可上桌。

recipes.title: 鸡子大饼

ingredients.item: 面粉500克、温水280克、纯酵母5克、生猪网油100克、鸡蛋10只。
葱25克、椒盐15克、白糖50克、色拉油500克。

steps: 将面粉加温水、酵母发酵成嫩发面
将生猪网油斩碎加入葱、椒盐、白糖拌和；发面摘成面坯，压扁，包入葱油，再揿成大的圆饼
平底锅内放油，烧热后将饼坯入平底锅煎至将熟时，在油锅内倒入打开的鸡蛋，将油饼覆盖在鸡蛋上煎至金黄色即成。

recipes.title: 鸡蛋壳布丁

ingredients.item: 鸡蛋3-{只}-（如果想蛋的味道更浓的话，可以用鸡蛋2-{只}-、蛋黄1个，或者鸡蛋1-{只}-、蛋黄2个）
以下两者任选其一：（白糖分量可随个人口味调整，也可用其他甜味剂代替）
香荚兰油几滴（也可用一小节香荚兰条代替；如果不加入香荚兰油或香荚兰条，布丁容易出现鸡蛋腥味）

steps: 用专门处理食物的剪刀，在鸡蛋顶部四分之一至五分之一处划一道线（绕着鸡蛋壳的圆周）。
敲开鸡蛋顶部（注意力度控制），倒出蛋黄和蛋白。（如果想蛋味更浓的话，可以筛出其中一只或两只蛋的蛋白，只用蛋黄）
沿着刚才划的线，小心地剪开鸡蛋壳的四分之一至五分之一。
撕走鸡蛋壳里面的气囊和薄膜。（这个步骤既费时又困难，薄膜通常会黏在蛋壳上，难以察觉和撕走。应尽可能撕走全部薄膜。）
打发鸡蛋。边打发鸡蛋，边加入忌廉。
加入糖、盐、牛奶，期间保持打发。
加入几滴香荚兰油，再彻底搅拌混合物。（如果用香荚兰条的话，需要把香荚兰条剪碎，放进混合物，然后彻底搅拌混合物，再用筛子移除香荚兰条）
把混合物倒进空鸡蛋壳（建议不要超过鸡蛋壳容量的一半，否则有溢出风险）。如果鸡蛋壳不够用的话，也可以倒进布丁杯。
如果用鸡蛋壳或者小型布丁杯：把鸡蛋壳放稳在蛋托上（如果没有蛋托，可自行用锡纸制作）。把蛋托连鸡蛋壳放到碟上，再把碟放进蒸锅，大火蒸4分钟。如果用容量较大的布丁杯：把布丁杯放到碟上，再把碟放进蒸锅，大火蒸6分钟。
只要布丁凝固，就可以食用。

recipes.title: 鸡蛋糕
steps: 無鹽奶油先稍微加熱融化備用。
蛋黃和蛋白分開，將蛋黃打散，分次加入牛奶拌勻。
粉類混合過篩，加入蛋黃拌勻（此階段不要過度攪拌，出筋後口感會不鬆軟）。
蛋白用攪拌器打發，分次加入蛋黃鍋內，用麵糊刮刀沿盆邊緣從底部用切的方式蛋白蛋黃拌勻，注意不要過度攪拌。
最後再加入融化無鹽奶油和少許香草拌勻。
製作好的麵糊，用刮刀提起會呈現緩緩下滑的稠度，靜置約20至30分鐘。
模具烤盤預熱10分鐘，準備奶油和刷子刷烤盤，麵糊半面倒滿，模具蓋上翻面，烤的時間約5分鐘，約2分鐘間隔翻個面。

recipes.title: 麦提莎糯米糍

ingredients.item: 麦提莎适量（可随个人口味选择牛奶巧克力味、咖啡巧克力味、白巧克力味、黑巧克力味；可用麦丽素代替）
糖霜适量（用于装饰糯米糍表面，可随个人口味调整分量，亦可不用，唯不能够用其他甜味剂代替）
可可粉适量（一部分用于黏上糯米糍表面，影响粉团的外观，可随个人口味调整分量，亦可不用；一部分用于加入糯米糍粉团，影响粉团的颜色和味道，可随个人口味调整分量，亦可不用）
白砂糖35克（可随个人口味调整分量，亦可用其他甜味剂代替）

steps: 把糯米粉和白砂糖加到大碗里。
把一部分鲜牛奶加到先前的混合物。（也可留待以后的步骤才加入）
搅拌混合物，直至形成粉浆。
把可可粉加到混合物裏。
把剩余的鲜牛奶加到混合物裏。
彻底搅拌，直至形成粉浆。
把粉浆倒到大碟里，准备蒸热。
用中至大火蒸粉浆25至30分钟。
用力把粉团搓至冷却。（否则麦提莎表面的巧克力会融化，可能影响成品口感）
捏起一小块粉团，搓成圆饼状。把一颗麦提莎放在圆形中央，再把圆饼状粉团的两对对角接起，以至把麦提莎完全包裹起来。
把可可粉和糖霜都加到小碗里，稍稍搅拌，再把糯米糍放到碗里打滚，直至整颗沾满可可粉和糖霜。一颗麦提莎糯米糍制成。

recipes.title: 黄金钻石曲奇

ingredients.item: 30克白糖（份量隨個人口味調整，可以替换为其他甜味剂）
60克红糖／黄糖／姜糖（份量隨個人口味調整；用以确保曲奇呈现金黄色，如果不要求卖相的话，可以替换为其他甜味剂）
适量咖啡糖（份量隨個人口味調整；用以黏在曲奇表面模仿钻石，可以替换为其他糖粒）

steps: 把黄油冷却至室温后，经粉篩加入白糖和紅糖／黃糖／薑糖，搅拌混和（建议使用打蛋器）。
加入半只鸡蛋，用打蛋器搅拌混和。
把泡打粉、肉桂粉、鹽混合起来，经粉篩加入低筋麵粉，再混合。把这个混合物分三次加到黄油、糖、鸡蛋的混合物，边加入边作大幅度搅拌。
把混合而成的面团放到工作台上，搓成圆棒或方棒形状，包好后在冰箱冷藏约半天，直至变硬。
冷藏后，在棒形面团表面上抹上少量水，用刀切成厚度不超过一厘米的小片（否则烘培效果不佳）。
准备一小盒咖啡糖，把面团片放到盒里，让面团片的两面和边缘都沾满糖。
把面团片排在鋪上烘焙紙的烤盤上，在室温下静置一会，再放進经攝氏180度预热的烤箱，以攝氏180度烘烤10分鐘。
烘烤完成后，冷却一会，食用。

name: 1-2-3-4 Cake
description: This is a traditional American recipe for a 1-2-3-4 cake, a simple form of yellow cake. The name comes from the volumetric ratio of butter to sugar, flour, and eggs.

recipes.title: 1-2-3-4 Cake

ingredients.item: 2 cups (450 g / 16 oz) white granulated sugar

steps: Preheat oven to 175 °C (350 °F)
Cream the butter and sugar together until fluffy.
Beat in the vanilla and eggs, one at a time, ensuring the batter is well mixed after each egg.
Gradually sift in the dry ingredients, alternating with small additions of the milk.
Transfer to a greased and floured baking pan.
Bake at 175 °C (350 °F), until a skewer inserted shows no moist crumbs.

name: 20-Ingredient Brownies
description: 20-ingredient brownies is a dessert containing 20 ingredients. It is adapted from recipe from the YouTube channel Tasty.

recipes.title: 20-Ingredient Brownies

ingredients.item: 1 cup (200 g / 7 oz) white granulated sugar
½ cup (60 g / 2 oz) dutch processed cocoa powder
½ cup (110 g / 4 oz) white granulated sugar
11 oz (330 ml / 1⅓ cups) heavy cream, heated

steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C (356°F). Line a 33 x 23 cm (13 x 9-inch) baking pan with parchment.
Melt dark chocolate in microwave using 30-second bursts. Leave it to cool.
Beat the butter and sugars in a large bowl until combined.
Beat in the eggs, salt and vanilla, then beat in the melted chocolate.
Fold in the flour and cocoa, then the chopped chocolate.
Pour the mixture into the lined baking pan.
Bake for 25 minutes.
Meanwhile, make the topping by beating the cheeses in a medium-sized bowl until soft.
Beat in the sugar and vanilla, then beat in the egg and milk.
Take the brownie out of the oven after the 25 minutes of baking.
Pour the mixture over the brownie and bake for a further 30 minutes.
Take the brownie out of the oven and leave it to cool.
Make the ganache by mixing together the chocolate, hot cream and salt in a bowl until melted.
Pour the ganache over the brownie and chill in the fridge for at least a few hours until set.
Sprinkle the brownie with a light sprinkle of salt.
Trim the brownie and cut into 15 squares.

recipes.title: 20-Minute Beef Stroganoff

ingredients.item: wide egg noodles (figures are for yolk-free noodles)
1 package () prepared beef tips with gravy
1 can () condensed cream of mushroom soup (figures are for fat-free)
¼ teaspoon (or more to taste) mild or hot paprika
½ cup () sour cream (figures are for reduced-fat)

steps: Prepare noodles according to package directions and drain.
As the noodles are boiling, warm oil in very deep skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add mushrooms and onions and cook until onion is soft, about 3 minutes.
Add beef tips, milk, and mushroom soup.
Add salt and pepper to taste and stir well.
Reduce heat to simmer and stir in garlic, paprika, and sour cream.
Simmer lightly, without letting it boil (that will curdle it).
When noodles are finished and drained, serve with noodles on serving plate or individual plates, with sauce over it.
Garnish with parsley.

recipes.title: 40 Cloves in a Roast Chicken

ingredients.item: ¼ cup Country Roast Chicken Seasoning

steps: Rub the Country Roast Chicken Seasoning under the skin of the chicken. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Tie the chicken's legs together and wing tips under the back with butcher's twine.
Heat garlic in a microwave on low for 6 minutes.
In this step, work quickly. If using a bag, place garlic in and stuff it in the cavity. If not, just stuff it in.
Coat chicken with olive oil. Place herbs in the bottom of a roasting pan and put lemon slices on top.
Put chicken breast side up on top and bake in an oven for 45 minutes at 375°F (190°C).
Turn the temperature up to 425°F (220°C) and bake for 45 more minutes or until the internal temperature in both the thigh and breast reaches 165°F (75°C) and the juices run clear.
Let rest for 10 minutes and serve.

name: A Nice Cup of Tea
description: A nice cup of tea is the usual answer in Britain and Ireland to any everyday problem. Nothing is so bad that a nice cup of tea with a friend or family member can't make it better.

recipes.title: A Nice Cup of Tea

ingredients.item: 3–5 measures of loose tea leaves or 3–5 tea bags
Sweetener, such as sugar or honey, to taste
Milk or lemon juice to taste

steps: Pour freshly-drawn water into a tea kettle, and heat it to your desired temperature. An electric kettle is fast and convenient.

Pour some hot tap water into your teapot and let stand for about several seconds to a minute to pre-warm it. Alternately, you can swish some of the hotter boiling water from your kettle around in the teapot for a few seconds. Pour out this water before adding the tea to the teapot.
If using loose tea, place it into an infuser, then into the teapot. If using teabags, place them into the teapot.

When the water reaches the preferred temperature, pour it from the tea kettle into the teapot. As you pour, try to avoid pouring directly onto the tea (especially important for green and white teas) to avoid scalding the leaves.

Allow the tea to infuse quietly (i.e. do not stir the teapot or "dunk the teabag"). Agitating the tea releases more of the bitter compounds and degrades the taste. Watch the time to avoid over-infusion, and remove the infuser or tea bag when the time is up.
Pour tea into your cup(s). Add sweetener and milk or lemon to taste.

name: Abacha Mmiri (Soaked Cassava Flakes)
description: Abacha mmiri (literally "water cassava flakes"), also known as bobozee, is a Nigerian snack prepared from cassava.

recipes.title: Abacha Mmiri (Soaked Cassava Flakes)
steps: Peel the cassava, then cut into slices 1 cm thick. Rinse well.
Boil the cassava in a large pot of water until cooked through.
Soak the cooked cassava in fresh water overnight. The next day, drain away any remaining water and rinse the cassava well.
Season the cassava to taste with the salt.
Serve the cassava with the coconut, palm kernel, and roasted groundnut.

name: Abuk-abuk (Sweet Steamed Sago Dumplings)
description: Abuk-abuk is a Malaysian steamed sweet dumpling made with sago. This version is made with white sugar, but gula melaka palm sugar is also used.

recipes.title: Abuk-abuk (Sweet Steamed Sago Dumplings)

ingredients.item: 8 ea. 2 cm pieces of pandan leaf

steps: Prepare a steamer over a few inches of simmering water.
Place the sago in a strainer, and rinse well under running water. Let drain.
Transfer the sago to a bowl, then mix in the coconut, salt, and food coloring.
Fill each banana leaf cone with a scoop of the sago mixture. It should fill the cone about halfway.
Place a scoop of sugar on top of the sago mixture.
Top the sugar with another scoop of the sago mixture.
Place a piece of pandan leaf on top of the sago mixture. Fold the banana leaf to fully enclose the packet.
Transfer the packets to the steamer, cover, and steam for 15–20 minutes.
Remove from the steamer and allow to cool.
Unwrap the packets and serve.

name: Abula (Nigerian Three Stews)
description: Abula (literally "mixture") is a dish common amongst Yoruba people of Nigeria. It is a combination of three different soups/stews: gbegiri, ewedu, and pepper sauce.

recipes.title: Abula (Nigerian Three Stews)

ingredients.item: 2 large pieces of meat, cut into pieces

steps: Soak the beans in water overnight. Remove and discard the skins.
Boil the beans in fresh water until very soft. Drain well.
Blend the beans to a purée using a blender. Set aside.
Boil the meat in a pot of water with onions and spices. Remove the meat and set aside.
Heat a small amount of palm oil in a pot. Add the blended beans, crayfish, salt, boiled meat, and dryfish. Cook until the fish is softened.
Boil the ewedu for about 15 minutes.
Soften with potash, then add a pinch of salt and stock cube.
Blend the ewedu mixture until smooth, and stir in the locust beans.
Reduce the heat, and allow to simmer.
Blend the pepper and tomato together until smooth.
Heat a small amount of oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the blended mixture, and cook until it loses the raw flavor.
Serve the pepper sauce in one dish with the gbegiri and ewedu.

name: Accra Cassava (Cameroonian Cassava Fritters)
description: Accra cassava is a popular cassava fritter eaten in Cameroon. It can be eaten as breakfast, lunch, or dinner and is best enjoyed fresh.

recipes.title: Accra Cassava (Cameroonian Cassava Fritters)

ingredients.item: 3 pounds grated cassava (can be frozen and thawed)
A good amount of vegetable oil

steps: Squeeze the grated cassava using a kitchen cloth or cheesecloth (like the one used for preparing homemade pap) to remove as much liquid as possible. The cassava should be very dry with little liquid.
Mash the bananas well using a fork, masher, or food processor.
Add the cassava and salt to the mashed banana in a medium sized bowl, and mix them together very well. The mixture should be firm enough that it can be rolled into balls.
Use your palms to roll about 2 tablespoons of the mixture into bite-size balls.
Heat the vegetable oil to 375 °F in a deep skillet or a saucepan. You can check the oil temperature by dropping in a 1-inch square of bread—it should take about 1 minute to brown.
Place the cassava balls gently into the hot oil and fry until golden brown. Do not overcrowd the pan—work in batches as necessary.
Remove the fritters from the hot oil, drain, and serve fresh.

name: Acevichada Sauce
description: Acevichado sauce is a recent contribution to Peruvian cuisine that highlights the country's blend of several cultures, including the Japanese diaspora at the end of the 19th century. The recipe is said to have originated during the 90s in Lima's Matsuei restaurant, which is famous for the creation of the iconic acevichado maki. The sauce, which is sometimes described as a "Leche de Tigre mayonnaise", references the Peruvian style of uramakizushi and has undergone several changes to this day. It is commonly used as a Nikkei-style sushi topping, but more recently, it is used for dipping mixed seafood fritters (jalea de mariscos) and even pizza or chicken wings!

recipes.title: Acevichada Sauce
steps: Pour the lime juice into a bowl.
Add the salt and test the flavor. It should be neither too salty nor too acidic. If needed, rectify by adding more salt or lime juice to find the right balance.
Add the onions, chiles, garlic, cilantro, hondashi, black pepper, and togarashi.
Cover with plastic wrap and reserve in the fridge for at least 15 minutes, so the flavors from the vegetables and spices can integrate into the lime juice.
Crack the eggs into a blender, and start blending at low speed.
While running the blender, very gradually start adding 250 ml of the oil until the mixture thickens to a mayonnaise consistency. Use more or less oil as needed.
Pause the blender, pour your leche de tigre into the mix, and start blending again.
Gradually stream in the remaining 125 ml oil until the mix thickens again.
Turn off the blender and taste for salt. If needed, add a little more salt, and blend again until it suits your taste.

name: Acid Drops
description: Acid drops are a hard candy or confection made very sour through the addition of acid. Citric acid and tartaric acid are commonly used.

recipes.title: Acid Drops

ingredients.item: ½ tsp (2.5 mL) cream of tartar

steps: Bring the sugar, water and cream of tartar to boil over medium-low heat. Stir gently until syrup reaches 310°F (155°C/hard crack stage) or is pale brown. Syrup should harden completely when dropped on to a cold plate and snap between the teeth when cold.
Pour the mixture onto an oiled heatproof work surface, and sprinkle with the citric acid.
Use a greased spatula to fold in the sides and thoroughly work the acid in.
When the candy is cool enough to touch but still pliable, roll it into sticks and snip off drop-sized bits.
Sift powdered sugar onto the candies, and shake to coat.
Allow to cool and harden completely. Store in an air-tight container.

name: Acorn Crusted Salmon
description: You can use any type of salmon for this dish. Typical seasons are June/July for Sockeye Salmon, July-November for Coho Salmon, and August/September for Chinook Salmon.

recipes.title: Acorn Crusted Salmon
steps: Use a food processor, blender or other method (meat tenderizer, etc.) to pulverize the acorns into a fine meal. If desired, toast the acorn meal for 5-7 minutes at 375°F/190°C/gas mark 5. Transfer the acorn meal to a dish.
Place the egg whites in a shallow dish. Coat each salmon fillet in egg white.
Coat each fillet with the acorn meal.
Transfer coated fillets to a slightly greased or non-stick baking sheet.
Bake for 10-15 minutes in a 425°F/220°C/gas mark 7 oven, or until the fish is flaky when pulled apart with a fork.
Serve.
Heat a few tablespoons of oil in in a frying pan over medium-high heat. When the oil is hot, add the coated salmon fillets.
Pan fry the salmon for 2–3 minutes per side, depending on the thickness of the fillet, until fish is flaky when pulled apart with a fork.
Serve.

name: Acorn Squash with Orange Marmalade
description: Acorn squash with orange marmalade is a quick, easy vegetable side dish that has great appeal due to its slight sweetness.

recipes.title: Acorn Squash with Orange Marmalade
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (204°C).
Remove seeds and strings from squash halves.
Cut a small piece off outside of each half to make a flat space on which the half can stand level.
Place halves in a shallow pan or casserole in ¼ inch (6 mm) water with insides facing down. Bake for 35 minutes.
Combine marmalade and butter in a small bowl.
Remove squash from oven, and invert in pan or dish. Salt lightly.
Spread marmalade and butter mixture on edges of squash, allowing excess to run into center.
Place under broiler for 5 minutes or until lightly browned.

name: Adobo Chicken (Philippine)
description: Adobo chicken is the most indigenous in the Philippines. It has evolved over the centuries to prepare foods that won't spoil easily in a tropical climate. The vinegar gives it a tangy taste and acts as a preservative. Each region has its own version, but pork and/or chicken are most commonly used. The steps below are the traditional way of making adobo. The soy sauce gives it a savoury taste.

recipes.title: Adobo Chicken (Philippine)

ingredients.item: 6–8 chicken pieces, preferably legs and wings
⅓ cup (80 ml) vinegar made from coconut juice (as a variant, try balsamic vinegar)
½ tsp (2.5 ml) freshly cracked (not ground) black peppercorns

steps: Put chicken, garlic, peppercorn, soy sauce and vinegar in a pan and bring to a boil.
When chicken is cooked, put chicken pieces in a colander and drain. Put aside the pot with soy sauce and vinegar.
When chicken pieces are no longer draining, fry them in hot oil at medium heat. Have a cover ready for splatters.
Sear the chicken, browning on all sides.
Put chicken pieces back in the pot with soy sauce and vinegar and bring to simmer. Add 1–2 pieces of bay leaf.

Cook until the sauce has largely evaporated; some take this to an extreme and cook until the sauce has thickened and adhered to the chicken, which begins to make a popping noise due to the high, direct heat.
Serve over hot steamed rice. May be eaten with tomato slices in fish sauce, tapsilog, soy sauce, vinegar, hotdog, etc.

name: Adobo Sauce
description: Adobo sauce is a sauce or marinade used in Latin American and Southwestern U.S.-style cooking, made of finely chopped or pureed chiles, garlic, vinegar, and often onions and tomatoes. Food that has been prepared with adobo is sometimes called adobado [http://www.cookinglight.com/cooking/cs/techniques/article/0,13803,232455-232428,00.html].

recipes.title: Adobo Sauce

ingredients.item: 12 chipotle peppers or smoked, dried jalapeño peppers (most co-ops can get these for you, or try the specialty produce section of your grocery store)
⅓ cup (80 ml) apple cider vinegar

steps: Combine all ingredients in a heavy saucepan. Cook over a very low heat for 1–2 hours until the chiles are very soft and the liquid has been reduced to about 1 cup. Alternatively, cook in a slow cooker overnight.
Beat with a mortar and pestle, or put in blender to puree for a thick sauce.

name: Adoyo (Nigerian Ogi Beverage)
description: Adoyo is a popular Nigerian drink that can be found on almost every street just like zobo, kunu, and fura da nono. It is made with boiling water decanted from ogi (pap) and pineapple, lemongrass, Lemon and/or orange. It is a natural drink that does not require any coloring.

recipes.title: Adoyo (Nigerian Ogi Beverage)

ingredients.item: Fresh or dried lemongrass leaves, rinsed

steps: Combine ogi water, pineapple, and lemongrass leaves in a pot. Simmer for at least 45 minutes.
Remove from the heat, and cool completely. Once cool, strain out the solids.
Place the sugar in a pot. Slowly melt it over medium heat, stirring, and cook until it reaches a light brown caramel.
Stir some hot water into the caramel to make a sauce—if you use cold water, it will crystallize. Set aside.
Sweeten the strained liquid with the caramel sauce, and serve.

name: Adult Macaroni and Cheese
description: This dish was developed as a macaroni and cheese dish for adults. Instead of cheddar, this recipe uses Fontina, mascarpone, Gruyere, cream cheese, and Swiss.

recipes.title: Adult Macaroni and Cheese

ingredients.item: ½ tsp (2.5 ml) kosher salt, plus more for the water
½ cup (60 g / 2.1 oz) grated Fontina
½ cup (60 g / 2.1 oz) grated Gruyere
½ cup (150 g / 5.3 oz) mascarpone cheese
½ cup (150 g / 5.3 oz) cream cheese
1¼ sticks (150 g / 5.3 oz) unsalted butter, divided

steps: In a gallon (~3.8 L) of salted boiling water, cook macaroni to al dente. Strain into a colander and rinse with cold water.
While pasta is cooking, in a heavy saucepan, melt 2 tbsp butter over medium heat. Once bubbling ceases, whisk in flour and cook, whisking continuously, until blonde.
Add remaining ingredients except butter. Once cheese is melted and sauce is smooth, add 1 tbsp butter, whisking continuously until melted. Repeat until all butter has been used.
Gently fold in macaroni and serve warm.

name: Affogato
description: Affogato, or "affogato al caffe", is an Italian preparation consisting of gelato or ice cream topped with espresso.

recipes.title: Affogato

ingredients.item: 1–2 shots espresso, or one long pull shot

steps: Either pour espresso over gelato and serve, or serve them side by side for diner to mix at the table.

name: African Cabbage Stew
description: This is a delicious and nutritious stew. It is very easy to prepare and does not require any special skills, although preparing it can take a lot of time.

recipes.title: African Cabbage Stew
steps: Heat the avocado oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Add the neatly chopped onions and cook until tender for about 2 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and celery and cook until fragrant.
Add the cabbage, potatoes, carrots, Italian seasonings, onion powder, garlic powder, bouillon cubes, smoked paprika, and water. Cover the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and let simmer for about 20 minutes.
Check the seasonings and adjust where necessary.
Remove and serve warm with any complimentary dish of your choice.

recipes.title: African Salad II

ingredients.item: Other meat and vegetables for the Abacha

steps: Soak the shredded abacha in cold water for 10 minutes until it softens. Pour boiling water over it and drain.
Rinse the ugba with warm water.
Dissolve the potash in water and sieve out any residual solids.
Stir the potash water with the palm oil in a pot until it forms a yellowish paste. Place on the heat, and stir in the ground ehu, pepper, crayfish, and seasoning.
Stir in the crushed stock cubes, diced onions, and ugba. Take off the heat.
Mix in the ogiri, then add meat and fish if using.
Mix in the abacha, allowing the ingredients to blend.
Add sliced utazi and salt to taste.
Garnish with chopped garden egg leaves and sliced onions.

name: Agar Jelly
description: This jelly dessert uses agar as a thickener, making it suitable for vegetarians.

recipes.title: Agar Jelly
steps: Put agar, sugar, and water in a saucepan and bring to boil.
Take off heat, and drain some of the water.
When cool, add in milk and almond extract.
Pour mixture into tin.
When completely cool, chill in the refrigerator for about 15 minutes until set.
Cut almond jelly into cubes.
Serve with fruit cocktail and syrup in a glass bowl.

name: Agbalumo Smoothie
description: Agbalumo smoothie is a delicious Nigerian smoothie made from African star apples.

recipes.title: Agbalumo Smoothie
steps: Peel the skin off the star apples and remove the seeds.
Transfer the peeled fruit to the blender.
Begin blending the fruit, adding water to get your desired consistency.
Sweeten to taste with honey or sugar.
Strain the smoothie through a sieve, and serve.

name: Agbugbu (Nigerian Pigeon Pea and Yam Porridge)
description: Agbugbu is a typical igbo food made from pigeon peas and yam. It is tasty and easy to prepare.

recipes.title: Agbugbu (Nigerian Pigeon Pea and Yam Porridge)

ingredients.item: Yam, cut into small pieces and rinsed

steps: Pick any dirt or debris out of the pigeon peas, then wash them and soak in water overnight.
Drain away the soaking water.
Cover the pigeon peas in fresh water, and bring to a boil. Cook until tender, then drain.
Boil the yam in water until tender, then drain.
Fry the onions, ground crayfish, ground pepper in a pan with palm oil.
Add the drained yam and pigeon peas, and stir gently.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve.

name: Agedashi Tofu
description: Agedashi tofu (or agedashi dofu) 揚げ出し豆腐 is a simple Japanese way to serve hot tofu. Silken (kinugoshi) firm tofu, cut into cubes, is lightly dusted with potato starch or cornstarch and then deep fried until golden brown. It's then served in a hot tentsuyu broth made of dashi, mirin, and shoyu (Japanese soy sauce), and topped with finely chopped green onions or grated daikon. It is eaten with chopsticks.

recipes.title: Agedashi Tofu
steps: Cut the soft tofu into rectangular pieces about 1 inch thick.
Arrange the layers on rack with paper towels and leave for 10–15 minutes to drain. Change the paper and turn over the slices.
In pan, mix sauce ingredients, and heat in a pan until boiling. Turn off the heat.
Sprinkle starch on a plate. Arrange the tofu slices on it. Sprinkle more starch over the tofu.
Heat the oil to 355°F (180°C) for deep frying.
Pat any excess starch off the tofu slices and slide them into the hot oil, one by one. Don't add too many slices at once, because the tofu lowers the oil temperature. Fry until golden, turning once.
Remove and drain on paper towels.
Arrange the tofu in a dish, and pour the sauce over top. Top with a mound of grated daikon (radish), a bit of grated ginger, and sliced green onions.

name: Ager Soup
description: Ager soup is a typical Nigerian draw soup prepared from the pulp obtained from ager tree. It is commonly consumed by the Tiv people.

recipes.title: Ager Soup
steps: Scrape off the white flaky skin of the ager stalk. Pound gently for a few minutes to remove the ager pulp.
Squeeze the pulp in a small amount of water to extract the slippery juice. Sieve this product to separate the juice from the fibres.
Heat a little water in a pot, and add the ager juice.
Add the palm oil, blended pepper, blended tomato, beef, and fish. Cook for few minutes, stirring continuously until an elastic consistency is achieved.
Add nune, maggi cubes, and salt to taste.
Serve with swallows as desired.

name: Agidi (Nigerian Cornstarch Swallow)
description: minutesCooking: 10 minutesTotal: 15 minutes

recipes.title: Agidi (Nigerian Cornstarch Swallow)
steps: Gradually mix the water into the corn starch until you get a smooth, lump-free mixture. If desired, add a little sugar to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a pot, and stir continuously over medium-low heat until it thickens to a smooth, custard-like consistency.
Add a little water around the sides of the pot, cover, and simmer for about 10 minutes
Stir well, and test for doneness by placing a small portion in cold water; if it sets firmly after cooling, the agidi is ready.
Transfer the mixture into containers or wrap in leaves, then allow it to cool completely and set before serving.

name: Agnolotti Pasta Soup (Agnolotti in Brodo)
description: Agnolotti in brodo is a very simple and delicious Italian pasta soup containing agnolotti, small ravioli filled most commonly with meat. This soup is delicious on a cold day when you haven't much time to devote to preparing a tasty meal. It is best served with some homemade garlic bread and a healthy salad.

recipes.title: Agnolotti Pasta Soup (Agnolotti in Brodo)

ingredients.item: 250 grams (8–9 ounces) of agnolotti or other small ravioli-type pasta
½ litre (2 cups) of chicken broth (canned or homemade) or ½ litre of water and 2 good-quality chicken stock cubes
1 dash (you decide how big or small) of sweet sherry

steps: Bring the chicken broth to a rolling boil. If using water and chicken stock cubes, bring the water to a boil, add the stock cubes and let dissolve.
Add the agnolotti and cook according to the instructions on the package.
Add the cream, freshly-ground black pepper, and chopped parsley about 2 minutes before the end of the cooking, and turn down the heat.
Add the dash of sherry just before serving. If serving to children, dish out their portions first, then add the sherry for the grown-ups.
Let stand for a few minutes to marry the flavors, then serve, sprinkled with grated Parmesan cheese and enjoy.

name: Air Fried Zucchini
description: This is a very quick recipe for cooking zucchini in an air fryer.

recipes.title: Air Fried Zucchini
steps: Dice zucchini into medium-sized squares.
Transfer zucchini to a bowl, and add olive oil to your preference. A few tablespoons is a good starting point.
Add the season salt, garlic powder, and onion powder. Toss to coat all the zucchini well.
Put in air fryer, and cook for 8 minutes at about 205 °C (400 °F) or until crispy.

name: Ají de Gallina (Peruvian Chili Chicken)
description: (Spanish for chili pepper chicken) is a traditional Peruvian dish which has its roots in the social upheaval of the French Revolution in 1789.

recipes.title: Ají de Gallina (Peruvian Chili Chicken)

ingredients.item: 3 hot yellow South American chilis (seeds and filaments removed): Adjust quantity for individual taste.
1.6 kg (3.5 lbs) boiled rice (flavored with chopped garlic and salt)

steps: Boil chicken in salted water together with the stock cube. Remove bones and break into bite size pieces, keeping the resulting chicken stock.
In a saucepan, heat oil and sauté the onion, garlic, and finely chopped chili peppers and add salt and pepper. Fry this until the onions are cooked and golden.
Soak the bread in two cups of the stock from the boiled chicken and place in a blender for a couple of minutes and then add the resulting liquid to the saucepan.
Cook slowly for ten minutes. Cook slowly, stirring to thicken.

While the Ají de Gallina is cooking slowly, boil the rice: first fry the garlic for a couple of seconds, then add the rice and the salt, then add the water. When the water starts to boil, let the rice cook in a closed pot very slowly for about 20 minutes or until the water has completely evaporated (hint: to cook "peruvian" rice: cook a cup of rice in two cups of water).

Back to the Ají de Gallina: add the chopped pecans, grated cheese, and chicken pieces. Cook until it has a thick creamy texture. About five minutes before serving, add the evaporated milk and continue cooking on low heat.
Serve over the boiled rice and garnish with halved potatoes, eggs quartered lengthwise, and olives.

name: Akabenz (Rwandan Fried Chicken)
description: Akabenz is a popular Rwandan dish consisting of crispy and flavorful fried chicken. This dish is loved for its juicy and tender meat, paired with a crispy outer coating. It is often served as a main course with various side dishes or enjoyed on its own as a snack.

recipes.title: Akabenz (Rwandan Fried Chicken)
steps: In a large bowl, combine the flour, salt, black pepper, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, dried thyme, and dried oregano. Mix well to ensure the spices are evenly distributed.
Coat each piece of chicken with the seasoned flour mixture, making sure to shake off any excess.
Heat vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. The oil should be hot but not smoking.
Carefully place the coated chicken pieces into the hot oil, ensuring they are not overcrowded in the pan. Fry in batches if necessary.
Fry the chicken for about 6–8 minutes per side or until golden brown and cooked through. The internal temperature should reach 165°F (74°C) for the chicken to be fully cooked.
Once cooked, transfer the fried chicken to a plate lined with paper towels to absorb any excess oil.
Serve immediately while still hot and crispy.

name: Akamu (Nigerian Pudding)
description: Akamu, also known as pap or ogi, is a variety of Nigerian pudding usually make from soaked corn. It is often eaten for breakfast.

recipes.title: Akamu (Nigerian Pudding)
steps: Fill a large basin halfway with the akamu lumps. Because akamu rises during preparation, use a bowl large enough to hold the meal in its elevated position. If in doubt, use a large bowl and allow plenty of time.
Crush the ogi lumps with a spoon into very little pieces. Mix in small amounts of cold water until the mixture is smooth and has the consistency of evaporated milk.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil.

Stir the mixture thoroughly just before the water boils, as some akamu may have accumulated at the bottom of the basin. Once the water has reached a boil, carefully but steadily stir it into the akamu mixture. Stop stirring as soon as the mixture starts to set, and reduce the flow of water you're pouring to the bare minimum until the akamu has entirely set.
Thoroughly whisk the mixture. Add additional water as desired if the mixture is too thick.
Stir in evaporated milk and a pinch of sugar to taste.

name: Akarange (Rwandan Tomato Sauce)
description: Akarange is a flavorful and versatile Rwandan tomato sauce that can be used as a base for many dishes. Made with ripe tomatoes and aromatic spices, this sauce adds a burst of flavor to various meals.

recipes.title: Akarange (Rwandan Tomato Sauce)
steps: Heat the vegetable oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pan. Sauté until the onion becomes translucent and fragrant.
Stir in the diced green and red bell peppers. Cook for a few minutes until they begin to soften.
Add the diced tomatoes to the pan, along with the ground paprika, ground cumin, ground coriander, and ground black pepper. Stir well to combine the ingredients.
Pour in the water and season with salt to taste. Stir again to ensure the spices are evenly distributed.

Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low. Cover the saucepan and let the akarange cook for about 15–20 minutes, or until the tomatoes have softened and the flavors have melded together.
Taste the sauce and adjust the seasoning if needed, adding more salt or spices according to your preference.
Once the akarange is cooked to your liking, remove the saucepan from the heat.

name: Akarubi (Rwandan Grilled Banana)
description: Akarubi is a popular Rwandan dessert made with grilled bananas. This simple yet delicious dish is a favorite among Rwandans and visitors alike. Grilled bananas are caramelized to perfection, resulting in a sweet and smoky flavor that is irresistible.

recipes.title: Akarubi (Rwandan Grilled Banana)

ingredients.item: Butter or vegetable oil, for grilling

steps: Preheat your grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Place the peeled bananas directly on the grill grates or grill pan.
Grill the bananas for 2–3 minutes on each side, or until they are lightly charred and softened.
Remove the grilled bananas from the heat and transfer them to a serving plate.
Optionally, sprinkle the grilled bananas with cinnamon for added flavor.
Serve hot as a dessert or snack. If desired, drizzle the grilled bananas with honey or maple syrup for additional sweetness.

name: Akpu
description: Akpu is a traditional swallow made from fermented cassava and widely consumed in southeastern Nigeria. It is a staple food among the Igbo people and is commonly served with soups such as onugbu soup, ora soup, oha soup, and egusi soup. The fermentation process gives Akpu its characteristic texture and flavour.

recipes.title: Akpu
steps: Peel the cassava tubers and wash thoroughly.
Place the cassava in a container and cover completely with water.
Allow it to ferment for 3–4 days or until softened.
Remove any fibres and hard portions from the fermented cassava.
Mash the cassava and sieve to obtain a smooth paste.
Suspend the paste in a clean cloth or sack and allow excess water to drain.
Transfer the fermented cassava paste into a pot.
Cook over medium heat while stirring continuously until a smooth, stretchy dough forms.
Shape into portions and serve hot with soup.

name: Alabama White Sauce
description: Alabama white sauce is a variety of mayonnaise-based white barbecue sauce. Its origin is frequently traced to Robert Gibson of Big Bob Gibson’s Bar-B-Q restaurant in Alabama. The sauce can be brushed on meat or used as a dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Alabama White Sauce
steps: Place all ingredients in a very large blender or food processor. Blend for 1 minute, or until thoroughly combined and mixture is smooth. Pour sauce into a large bowl.

Use when grilling chicken or other poultry or meat; brush lightly over the chicken (or meat) during the last few minutes of grilling. This sauce is also great for dipping; set some sauce aside for passing at the table.

name: Albanian Fried Meatballs
description: Fried meatballs (qofte të fërguara) is an Albanian dish.

recipes.title: Albanian Fried Meatballs
steps: Soak bread in water and squeeze hard to drain.
Combine soaked bread, ground meat, bread crumbs, oil or melted butter, onion, cheese, parsley, salt, pepper, and mint, and mix thoroughly.
Form mixture into 1 inch-thick patties, then sprinkle with salt, pepper, and oregano.
Roll in flour and fry in hot oil.
Serve hot with French fries or mashed potatoes.

name: Albanian Meat with Walnuts
description: Gjellë me arra is an Albanian dish of meat with walnuts. It is often made with veal or chicken.

recipes.title: Albanian Meat with Walnuts

ingredients.item: 2–3 lbs of veal or chicken meat, cut into 1-inch cubes

steps: Place the meat or chicken in a saucepan, and cook over medium heat until tender.
Remove the meat, and set it aside in a dish while leaving the remaining juices in the saucepan.
In another saucepan, add the flour and stir over heat until it becomes light brown in color—do not overcook! Then, add half the butter.
Add the walnuts, garlic, and egg yolks, stirring constantly.
Add the meat juices from the other saucepan, and stir until all the ingredients thicken. Immediately remove from the heat to avoid solidifying the egg yolks. Fold in the meat.
Pan fry the remaining half stick of butter until brown, and pour over the dish before serving.

name: Albanian Mixed Vegetables
description: Several different dishes are called "mixed vegetables"; they all consist primarily of different kinds of vegetables cut into pieces and mixed together, then either served as-is or else cooked, typically by sautéing. This recipe is for an Albanian mixed vegetables dish called Turli perimesh.

recipes.title: Albanian Mixed Vegetables

ingredients.item: 2 lbs of various vegetables (peppers, eggplant, okra, zucchini, potatoes, etc.)

steps: Cut off inedible tips of vegetables. Wash and slice them into 1-inch squares.
Sauté vegetables in half the oil and remove them from the frying pan.
Sauté onion and tomatoes in the remaining oil, and season with parsley, salt, and pepper.
Put everything in a stock pot with a cup of water, cover tightly, and simmer until almost all moisture has cooked away.
Serve hot, accompanied by steak, meatballs, or any other main dish.

name: Albanian Stewed Fig Pudding
description: Stewed dry figs (hoshaf me fiq të thatë) is an Albanian pudding.

recipes.title: Albanian Stewed Fig Pudding
steps: Stir sugar into milk, bring to a boil, and remove from heat. Gradually add figs, stirring continuously.
Pour into earthenware serving bowls and bake in moderate oven (350°F or 180°C) for 10 minutes.
Chill and sprinkle with cinnamon.
Serve cold.

name: Albanian Vegetable Pie
description: Albanian vegetable pie (Albanian: Byrek Shqipëtar me perime), is an Albanian recipe for cooking pies. Albanian pies are generally made of thin pastry leaves which can be rolled out at home or bought as filo dough at a supermarket. Most of the pies prepared by Albanian cooks are not sweet; instead, pie fillings are almost always savory. Thus, a piece of such a pie may well serve as the main dish of a meal.

recipes.title: Albanian Vegetable Pie

ingredients.item: 1 cup (240 ml) oil, preferably olive oil
1½ packets (or about 30 ea.) filo pastry leaves
½ cup (120 ml) chopped green onions

steps: Brush a medium-sized baking pan with some of the oil, and start layering the pastry leaves inside. First, lay two leaves, sprinkle or brush with oil, then lay two more leaves, and repeat the procedure until half of the leaves are in place. Make sure that they cover the pan by hanging them about one inch over the edges of the pan.

Sprinkle spinach with salt, then mix well by hand. Add the feta cheese, oil, onions, eggs and salt, and spread this mixture over the already laid pastry leaves. Finish by covering the spinach with the rest of the pastry leaves, repeating the first-half procedure.
Roll the hanging edges of the bottom leaves over the pie (think of a pizza crust).
Sprinkle top with oil and bake moderately at 350°F (175°C) for about 45 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve hot, accompanied with buttermilk, or beaten yogurt, thinned down in cold water or with chilled stewed prunes. Sometimes a green salad adds to the meal!

name: Ale, Mustard and Winter Vegetable Pie
description: Ale, Mustard and Winter Vegetable Pie is a vegan pie. It is typically enjoyed in autumn and winter.

recipes.title: Ale, Mustard and Winter Vegetable Pie

ingredients.item: ½ small turnip or rutabaga, chopped
¼–½ cup dried TVP (textured vegetable protein)
2 heaped tablespoon wholegrain mustard (try a green peppercorn mustard, if available)
200 ml (¾ cup) rich, dark ale (try a nice Porter)

steps: Drop the potato, turnip or rutabaga, and ½ parsnip in a saucepan of rapidly boiling water.
Bring back to the boil, and simmer until potato is soft (about 20 minutes).
When cooked, drain off the water, add the margarine, and mash until creamy smooth.
Set aside.
Reconstitute the TVP by mixing the TVP, boiling water and marmite. Let sit.
Put olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat, then add the leek, garlic and carrot and ½ parsnip. Sauté until the carrot is soft.
Add the mushrooms and cook a minute or two more.
Add the flour and stir like mad for a solid 30 seconds. Still stirring, add the TVP and its soaking broth to soak up the flour and thicken.
Add the mustard, ale and some black pepper. Stir to mix all very well. Simmer for about 10 minutes to thicken the sauce.
Pour into a casserole dish, top with the potato/rutabaga/parsnip mash, and smooth the top.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 20 to 30 minutes or until top is beginning to brown.
Remove from oven, let rest a minute, then serve.

name: Alfajores (Latin American Sandwich Cookies)
description: Alfajores are a Latin-American sandwich cookie filled with dulce de leche.

recipes.title: Alfajores (Latin American Sandwich Cookies)
steps: Cream butter; add sugar and beat until fluffy.
Add egg and egg yolks one at a time, beating well. Beat in vanilla and lemon rind.
Sift together cornstarch, flour, baking powder, and salt. Add to batter and mix well.
Drop batter by small spoonfuls onto well-buttered baking sheet.
Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes. Remove immediately and cool.
Sandwich the cookies together with dulce de leche.

name: Alfredo Sauce
description: Fettuccine Alfredo or "fettuccine all’Alfredo" is a dish made with fettuccine pasta combined with a sauce made from Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese and butter. The dish was named after Alfredo Di Lelio who opened a restaurant in Rome in 1914 and served “fettuccine all’Alfredo. Fettuccine Alfredo is an exaggerated variation of "pasta al burro" or pasta with butter--a dish that Italians understand better as something that would be cooked at home for simplicity and comfort. The dish became popularized in the United States and through commercialization the recipe has evolved to include heavy cream and other ingredients.

recipes.title: Alfredo Sauce

ingredients.item: 8 oz (2 sticks / 230 g) of butter, unsalted and softened to room temperature
½ pound (230 g) Parmigiano Reggiano cheese (aged 24 months), grated

steps: Whisk together the butter and grated Parmesan-Reggiano cheese until it is creamy. Both ingredients combined should be on the thick side.
Put water to boil in a large pot and cook the noodles until al dente.
Drain the noodles and reserve ½ cup of liquid to emulsify your sauce.
Put noodles back in the warm pot and stir in the butter and cheese mixture with vigorous turning motion while adding pasta water until the noodles are glistening and smooth.
Add salt to taste.
Serve immediately.

name: Algerian Baghrir
description: Baghrir are a variety of small, spongy pancake or flatbread popular in North Africa, including Algeria. They are made of semolina and/or all-purpose flour, and they are characteristically laced with tiny holes that soak up whatever sauce they are served with. The recipe is quick, simple, and uncomplicated.

recipes.title: Algerian Baghrir
steps: Combine the semolina, flour, yeast, sugar, and salt in a bowl.
Mix in the water and egg until you get a smooth batter.
Set batter aside, and let rest for 15–20 minutes or until doubled in size.
Thin with a little water if necessary, then whisk in the baking powder.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Lightly grease the skillet, then dollop in enough batter to make a few small pancakes.
Cook the pancakes on one side until the top is covered in holes and fully cooked. Do not flip and cook on the second side.
Remove baghrir from the pan, and repeat the cooking process with any remaining batter.
Serve with butter.

name: Algerian Chakhchoukha (Vegetable and Flatbread Stew)
description: Chakhchoukha is an Algerian dish prepared for festive celebrations, consisting of a vegetable stew to which small pieces of flatbread or semolina dough are added. Typically the flatbread is either rougag or trid. There are two types—chakhchoukha from Biskra and chakhchoukha Dfar—which differ in the type of flatbread used. This particular recipe is for chakhchoukha Biskra. The dish often includes or is served with meat, typically lamb, though beef or chicken can also be used.

recipes.title: Algerian Chakhchoukha (Vegetable and Flatbread Stew)

ingredients.item: 2 cups dried chickpeas, soaked and drained

steps: Heat some olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, salt, pepper, paprika, and tomato paste, and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the tomato, chickpeas, and chili pepper, and cook for 10–15 minutes.
Add the meat and enough boiling water to slightly cover everything. Let the mixture cook for approximately 45 minutes, or until the meat and chickpeas are cooked and the sauce is thick.
Rip the sheets of rougag with your hands into tiny pieces. Place them in the top of a steamer and steam for 5 minutes, then remove and set aside.
Adjust the seasoning of the stew, adding salt if necessary.
Place the meat and vegetables over the rougag in a dish, and pour the sauce on top.
Serve hot.

name: Algerian Coca
description: Algerian coca (كوكة) is a savory pastry that is popular in Algeria, particularly in the city of Oran. It is similar to a thin-crust pizza or a flatbread, often topped with a variety of ingredients such as onions, tomatoes, peppers, and sometimes meat or fish.

recipes.title: Algerian Coca
steps: In a bowl, dissolve the sugar in warm water, then sprinkle the yeast. Let sit 10 minutes until frothy.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour and salt. Make a well in the center and pour in the yeast mixture and olive oil. Mix until a dough forms.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead for about 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover with a clean kitchen towel, and let it rise in a warm place for about 1 hour or until it doubles in size.
Heat the olive oil over medium heat in a large skillet. Add the sliced onions and cook until they become soft and translucent, about 10 minutes.
Add the garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper to the onions. Stir well and cook for another 2–3 minutes.
Add the sliced tomatoes and bell peppers to the skillet. Cook for another 5–7 minutes until the vegetables are soft but not mushy. Remove from heat and let it cool slightly.
Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F).
Press the risen dough to deflate it, then divide it into two equal portions. Roll out each portion into a thin rectangle or oval shape, about ¼ inch thick.
Transfer the rectangles to one or more baking sheets lined with parchment paper. Spread the cooked vegetable mixture evenly over the rolled-out dough.
Bake in the preheated oven for about 20–25 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the dough is cooked through.
Remove the coca from the oven and let it cool slightly. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and olives if desired.
Cut into squares or slices and serve warm.

name: Algerian Couscous with Meat and Vegetables
description: Algerian couscous (Arabic: كسكس, Berber: ⵙⴽⵙⵓ) is a traditional Algerian dish that holds a central place in Algerian cuisine. It is a staple food in Algeria, often served during family gatherings, religious celebrations and special occasions. Algerian couscous is characterized by its light, fluffy texture, aromatic spices and a rich stew of meat, vegetables and legumes.

recipes.title: Algerian Couscous with Meat and Vegetables

ingredients.item: 500 g (about 2½ cups) fine or medium couscous
250 ml (1 cup) water mixed with 1 teaspoon salt
500 g (1 lb) lamb, chicken, or beef, cut into chunks
½ teaspoon cinnamon (optional, for a hint of sweetness)
2 carrots, peeled and cut into chunks
2 potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks
1 turnip, peeled and cut into chunks
1 cup pumpkin or other hard squash, cut into chunks
1 green bell pepper, cut into chunks

steps: To hydrate the couscous, mix the couscous with olive oil and a little salt in a large bowl. Rub the grains between your hands to coat them evenly with oil. Gradually add the warm water while stirring to moisten the couscous. Let it sit for 10 minutes to absorb the water.

Transfer the couscous to a couscoussier (a traditional steamer) or a fine-mesh steamer basket. Steam over simmering water for 20 minutes, fluffing the couscous with a fork every 10 minutes to prevent clumping. If you don’t have a steamer, you can use a colander placed over a pot of boiling water, covered with a lid.
After the first steam, transfer the couscous back to a large bowl.
Gradually sprinkle the salted water over the couscous while using your hands or a fork to break up any clumps. This step ensures the couscous is evenly seasoned and moist.
Let the couscous cool for 10–15 minutes. This allows the grains to absorb the salted water and prepares them for the second steam.
In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the meat and brown it on all sides. Remove and set aside.
In the same pot, add the chopped onions and garlic. Sauté until softened and golden.
Stir in the tomato paste, cumin, coriander, paprika, turmeric, and cinnamon (if using). Cook for 2–3 minutes to release the flavors.
Return the meat to the pot and add the water or broth. Season with salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover and simmer for about 1 hour or until the meat is tender.
Return the couscous to the steamer. Steam for another 20 minutes, fluffing with a fork every 10 minutes. This second steam ensures the couscous is light, fluffy and fully cooked.
After the meat has simmered for 30 minutes, add the carrots, turnip and potatoes. Continue simmering for another 15 minutes.
Add the zucchini, pumpkin and chickpeas. Cook until all the vegetables are tender but not mushy (about 15–20 minutes).
Once the couscous is steamed for the second time, transfer it to a large serving dish. Drizzle a ladle of broth from the stew over the couscous, and fluff it with a fork to separate the grains.
Place the couscous on a large platter, arrange the meat and vegetables on top, and pour some of the broth over everything.

name: Algerian Lemonade
description: Algerian lemonade (Lemon Cherbet) is a refreshing Algerian drink. The drink's name differs depending on the various names for lemon throughout Algeria (Cherbet Elkarass, Cherbet Lim, Cherbet Laymoun). It is generally called Cherbet or Citronnade Algérienne and it usually served during in Algeria.

recipes.title: Algerian Lemonade
steps: Zest one lemon, stop before reaching the white part of the lemon and reserve for later.
Slice one lemon and reserve for later.
Press the rest of the lemons to obtain lemon juice and reserve for later.
Pour half a litre of water into a saucepan, add the lemon slices and sugar, and let it boil on medium heat. Turn off the heat and let it cool down completely.
In a jug, add water, lemon zest, orange blossom water, milk, and lemon juice. Mix well.
Add your mixture into a clean bottle, add the remaining water and cooled down lemon juice from the saucepan. Close the bottle and shake well.
Transfer the drink to a pitcher, and let it cool in the fridge.

name: Algerian Mint Tea
description: Algerian Mint Tea (Atay Djazairi) is an Algerian drink. Mint tea is a popular drink all over North Africa and its preparation varies from one country to another. Algerian Mint Tea is prepared by boiling dried green tea and fresh mint leaves in water and sugar. It is poured in small glass cups from very high to allow the hot water to oxygenate, the tea to develop its aromas and to obtain a fine foam on top of the drink.

recipes.title: Algerian Mint Tea
steps: Boil water in a saucepan.
Put 2 tsp of dried green tea in the teapot.
Pour half a glass of boiling water into the teapot, stir and then empty the water to rinse the tea and get rid of its sour aftertaste.
Fill the teapot with boiling water and then add the fresh mint leaves, which should have been rinsed carefully beforehand.
Add the sugar cubes to the teapot then leave it on low to medium heat for a few minutes.
The tea is ready when the water comes to a boil.

name: Alicha Wot (Mild Ethiopian Stew)
description: Alicha wot is a mild and flavorful Ethiopian stew known for its aromatic spices and comforting flavors. Unlike its spicier counterparts, alicha wot features a milder seasoning profile, making it a great choice for those who prefer a less fiery dish.

recipes.title: Alicha Wot (Mild Ethiopian Stew)

ingredients.item: ½ teaspoon salt, or to taste
Fresh cilantro or parsley, chopped, for garnish

steps: Heat the olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions to the pot and sauté until they become translucent and slightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pot and sauté for an additional minute until fragrant.
Stir in the berbere spice blend, tomato paste, ground turmeric, ground cumin, ground coriander, salt, and black pepper. Mix well to combine the spices with the onions, garlic, and ginger.
Add the beef to the pot and stir to coat it with the spice mixture. Cook the beef for a few minutes until it is browned on all sides.
Pour in the beef broth or water, ensuring that the beef is fully submerged in the liquid. Bring the mixture to a boil.

Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for about 1 hour, or until the beef is tender and the flavors have melded together. Stir occasionally and add more liquid if needed to maintain the desired consistency.
Taste the stew and adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper if needed.
Remove the pot from the heat and let rest for a few minutes before serving.
Garnish with fresh chopped cilantro or parsley. Serve hot with injera or bread, and enjoy the mild yet flavorful experience of this Ethiopian stew.

name: Alkubus (Nigerian Steamed Bread)
description: Alkubus is a steamed wheat bread from northern Nigeria. It originated from Arabs.

recipes.title: Alkubus (Nigerian Steamed Bread)
steps: Sift the flour into a mixing bowl. Mix in the yeast, salt, and baking powder.
Mix in the water to make a dough, and knead it until cohesive and fully combined.
Cover the dough and let rise for 1 hour.
Gently deflate the dough.
Grease a cooking mold, and transfer the dough to the mold.
Cover the mold and place it in a steamer setup. Steam until cooked through and a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from the heat and let cool.
Unmold the steamed bread and serve.

name: Almond-Cowitch Matcha Smoothie
description: Mucuna pruriens, commonly known as cowitch or velvet bean, is sometimes used as a coffee substitute; however, cooking leaches out chemical compounds such as levodopa (L-DOPA). If consumed unprocessed in large quantities as food, they are toxic to non-ruminant mammals, including humans.

recipes.title: Almond-Cowitch Matcha Smoothie
steps: Put 1⅛ cups (265 ml) almonds, ½ cup (118 ml) cowitch, and ½ cup (118 ml) almonds separately into 3 bowls of water. Make sure they are covered completely underneath at least 1 inch (2.5 cm) of water. This is called sprouting or steeping. Leave them in the refrigerator overnight, and then drain the water. Absolutely do not drink this water, since it has absorbed many of the toxins.

Put the 1⅛ cups of almonds from the previous step into a blender and add 3⅜ cups (796 ml) of fresh water. Begin blending. The mixture will start clear and quickly change color. Stop blending after a few minutes when there is no visible change in color or consistency anymore. Wash and dry your hands, and strain this mixture over a pitcher. You can either strain it through a fine sieve by squeezing the milk from the moist mixture through the sieve with a wooden spoon, or simply place mesh sometimes called a sprout or nut-milk bag that is usually made of nylon on top of the pitcher in order to squeeze the mixture through the mesh by hand. You may either discard the pulp or use it for other recipes, such as mixing it into almond agar jelly. Wash and dry your hands, and then pour the almond milk into ice cube trays. Place the ice cube trays into the freezer and remove when frozen.

Put the rest of the almonds and cowitch with 3 cups (708 ml) of fresh water into the blender. Begin blending. Just like before, this mixture will start clear and quickly change color. Stop blending after a few minutes when there is no visible change in color or consistency anymore. Wash and dry your hands, and strain this mixture over a pitcher. You can in the same way as you did in the previous step. Discard the pulp, and absolutely do not eat it, since it has many toxins. Do not drink or taste the liquid at this point. Wash and dry your hands, and put this liquid back in the blender. Blend in the dates, matcha, and milk thistle. If you are only going to make part of the mixture now, refrigerate what you’re not going to use and save for later in the refrigerator.
When well blended, pulse the liquid mixture with ice made from the almond milk until you reach the consistency you desire. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Almond Fudge Brownies

ingredients.item: ¾ cup (1.2 dl) butter or margarine
½ tsp almond extract or ½ cup (120 ml) chopped almonds

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Cream butter and sugar.
Beat in oil and milk.
Blend in eggs, one at a time.
Mix in vanilla and almond extract (or almonds).
Mix in cocoa and flour.
Spread into greased 10.5 x 7-inch cake pan.
Bake for 28–30 minutes. A toothpick inserted into the center should come out with no more than moist crumbs.
Allow to cool completely.

name: Almond Gambols
description: This 18th century recipe for almond cookies has been adapted from a handwritten recipe book hosted at Wiki Commons. They are very aromatic.

recipes.title: Almond Gambols
steps: Start pounding the almonds in a marble mortar.
Gradually pound in the sugar a spoonful at a time until it is all incorporated.
Pound in the rosewater, musk, ambergris, and lemon zest until the mixture is a fine paste.
Pinch off balls and roll them in some additional sugar, then place on parchment-lined sheets. Bake in a slow oven (275–300°F/135–150°C) until dried through.

recipes.title: Almond Meringue
steps: Whip the egg whites to soft peaks.
Add the sugar, a little at a time, and continue beating to firm peaks.
Fold in the almond meal carefully, being careful not to deflate the egg whites.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Draw circles of the desired diameter on the paper using a pair of compasses or a dinner plate.
Fill a pastry bag with the meringue and starting in the centre, then pipe a spiral of meringue toward the outer edge to form a flat disc about ½ inch thick.
Bake at 325°F (160°C) for about 25 minutes until hard and dry.
Allow to cool before peeling off the paper.

name: Almond Milk I
description: Almonds are soaked and ground to make almond milk, a plant-based beverage that can be used as a nondairy milk substitute.

recipes.title: Almond Milk I
steps: Soak the almonds in the water overnight. They should swell and become supple.
Grind the soaked almonds and water in a blender. Blend in a pinch of salt and a few dates if desired.
Strain the almond mixture through a fine filter to remove the almond solids. Folded cheesecloth or a nut milk bag work well.
Use the almond milk immediately or chill.

name: Almond Milk II
description: Almond milk is a plant milk used in a variety of cultures. Plant milks are often a vegan substitute for dairy, and are suitable for people with lactose intolerance or who want a dairy milk alternative.

recipes.title: Almond Milk II

ingredients.item: pure water, such as , orange blossom water, spring water, distilled water, or iodized water

steps: Put the almonds into a bowl, and cover them with at least one 1 inch (2.5 cm) of water. Leave them in the refrigerator overnight, and then drain the water. This is called sprouting or steeping.

Put the drained almonds into a blender, and blend in the 3 cups (708 ml) of water. The mixture will start clear and quickly change color. Stop blending after a few minutes when there is no visible change in color or consistency anymore.

Strain this mixture over a pitcher. You can either strain it through a fine sieve by squeezing the milk from the moist mixture through the sieve with a wooden spoon, or simply place mesh sometimes called a sprout or nut-milk bag that is usually made of nylon on top of the pitcher in order to squeeze the mixture through the mesh by hand. You may either discard the pulp or use it for other recipes, such as mixing it into almond .
Return the strained almond milk into the blender. Add the dates and blend until there is no longer any visible change in color or consistency.
Refrigerate or pour into a drinking cup and consume.

recipes.title: Almond Pancakes

ingredients.item: 1 cup (150 g / 5.3 oz) bleached all-purpose flour

steps: Heat a large non-stick skillet or griddle over low heat while preparing ingredients.
Mix flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, and baking soda in medium bowl.
Microwave buttermilk and milk in a 2-cup Pyrex measuring cup to room temperature, 20 to 30 seconds.
Whisk in egg, butter, and almond extract.
Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and whisk until just mixed.
Return batter to measuring cup, stirring in a teaspoon or two of water, if necessary, to make a thick, but pourable batter.
Increase heat to medium and generously brush skillet or griddle with oil.
